basic_details.job_title: BPBCC Lower Division Clerk Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 12 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Bihar Police Building Construction Corporation (Bihar Police Bhavan Nirman Nigam), a Government of Bihar undertaking, invites applications for 12 Lower Division Clerk (Nimn Vargiya Lipik) posts on contract basis at Rs. 28,000/- per month. The application in the prescribed form must reach the office of the Additional Director General of Police-cum-Chairman-cum-Managing Director, Bihar Police Building Construction Corporation, Kautilya Nagar, Patna-14, Bihar, by post or in person, by 5.30 PM on 14 December 2026. Applications sent by email will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: About the Corporation
content_sections.text: Bihar Police Building Construction Corporation is an undertaking of the Government of Bihar with its head office at Kautilya Nagar, B.M.P.-5, Thana-Hawai Adda Thana, Patna-800014. Its Corporate Identification Number (CIN), printed on the letterhead, is U45200BR1974SGC001126. The notice is signed by the Secretary of the Corporation.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must be made in the prescribed form, which is attached to the notice (pages 2 and 3) and can be downloaded from the Corporation website https://bpbcc.bihar.gov.in/ . It must be submitted to this address, by post or by appearing in person: Office of the Additional Director General of Police-cum-Chairman-cum-Managing Director, Bihar Police Building Construction Corporation, Kautilya Nagar, Patna-14, Bihar Download the prescribed application form for the post of Lower Division Clerk on contract basis from https://bpbcc.bihar.gov.in/ . Fill in the form: personal details, age as on 01-12-2026, category, permanent and present address with PIN code, 10th and 12th marks (minimum 60%), computer course, accounting software proficiency (if any), experience with the CIN/GSTIN number of each institution, and Aadhaar number. Paste a self-attested recent photograph in the box on the form. Sign the declaration that no case has been filed against you in any police station or court, that you are not on bail and that you have never been convicted. Attach legible self-attested copies of the documents listed under Enclosures, along with 2 extra photographs. Send the application by post or hand it in at the office in Patna so that it is received by 5.30 PM on 14.12.2026. Applications received by email will not be considered, and applications not received by the fixed date and time will not be considered. The notice does not mention what to write on the envelope.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: All 12 posts are for Lower Division Clerk. The category-wise break-up printed in the notice is: The benefit of reservation for these posts is available only to original residents (domicile) of Bihar. Passed both Class 10th and Class 12th with minimum 60 percent marks from a recognised board/university. Knowledge of computer typing (English and Hindi) is mandatory. Basic knowledge of computer operations, Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint presentation, office applications and data handling is mandatory. At least 03 years' experience of working on an equivalent post in a government undertaking / public undertaking / private institution. The experience must be from a company or institution with a CIN/GSTIN, which is mandatory. Preference will be given to candidates with knowledge of Accounting Software (Tally etc.), basic bookkeeping/taxation. The minimum age is 21 years as on 01.12.2026. The maximum age limit differs by category: The remuneration for the Lower Division Clerk post is Rs. 28,000/- per month. Persons engaged on contract will not be treated as government servants and will not be entitled to any facility admissible to government servants. Candidates should check the official notification for the complete eligibility conditions of the post.

rows.posts: 03 (01 for EBC women under horizontal reservation)

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Legible self-attested copies of these documents must be attached to the application: Educational qualification certificates (10th and 12th mark sheets and others) Caste certificate Residence certificate EWS certificate Certificate relating to date of birth Experience certificate (with the company's CIN/GSTIN) Computer typing certificate (Hindi and English) Certificate relating to computer knowledge Accounting software certificate (Tally, basic bookkeeping/taxation), if any Other necessary certificates and documents 2 extra photographs, besides the self-attested recent photograph on the form

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for the engagement will be made by a selection committee constituted by the Corporation. Shortlisted candidates will be informed about the interview on the email address given by them or on the Corporation website. At the time of the interview, candidates must bring the original certificates of date of birth, educational qualification, caste, residence, experience and computer knowledge, the certificate of Accounting Software (Tally etc.), basic bookkeeping/taxation knowledge if they have it, and other related certificates. No travelling allowance of any kind will be paid for the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many Lower Division Clerk vacancies are there in BPBCC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 12 posts: 02 SC, 03 EBC, 01 EWS and 6 Unreserved, with 1 EBC and 2 UR posts for women under horizontal reservation.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for the BPBCC Lower Division Clerk application?
faq.answer: The application must be received at the Corporation's office in Patna by 5.30 PM on 14 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the BPBCC Lower Division Clerk post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed both 10th and 12th with minimum 60% marks, with knowledge of computer typing (English and Hindi) and basic computer operations, MS Excel, PowerPoint, office applications and data handling.

faq.question: Q4. How much experience is required?
faq.answer: At least 03 years on an equivalent post in a government undertaking, public undertaking or private institution, with the CIN/GSTIN of the company or institution mandatory.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the BPBCC Lower Division Clerk post?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 21 years as on 01.12.2026; the maximum is 37 years for UR men, 40 years for UR women and EBC men/women, and 42 years for SC.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of a BPBCC Lower Division Clerk?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs. 28,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the BPBCC Lower Division Clerk post?
faq.answer: Fill the prescribed form from https://bpbcc.bihar.gov.in/, attach self-attested documents and 2 extra photographs, and send it by post or in person to the office of the ADGP-cum-Chairman-cum-Managing Director, Bihar Police Building Construction Corporation, Kautilya Nagar, Patna-14, Bihar.

faq.question: Q8. Can I send the application by email?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that applications received by email will not be considered.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection will be made by a selection committee constituted by the Corporation; shortlisted candidates will be informed about the interview by email or on the Corporation website.

faq.question: Q10. Is the BPBCC Lower Division Clerk job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is temporary, on contract for one year, which may be extended on the basis of efficiency and performance, with no claim to regularisation.
